title: Senior Manager - Digital Workplace
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. About the Role We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead our Microsoft 365 and Digital Workplace strategy, operations, and innovation. You’ll oversee M365 implementation, administration, and optimization — including Exchange Online, Share Point Online, Teams, One Drive, Intune, and related services — while ensuring endpoints are secure, reliable, and productive. This role also owns secure virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) for contractors, corporate laptop and mobility catalogs, including setting strategy and hardware standards that align with business needs and lifecycle best practices. Your mission: enable a modern, collaborative, and secure digital workplace that drives productivity across the organization Why Join Us In this role, you’ll shape the digital workplace for our entire organization, from collaboration tools to the very laptops our employees use. You’ll work with cutting-edge Microsoft technologies, drive enterprise adoption, and directly impact how we work every day. Key Responsibilities Leadership Lead and mentor a high-performing team of M365 admins, developers, and endpoint professionals. Develop and execute the M365 and endpoint strategy aligned to business goals. Act as a thought leader on collaboration tools, security best practices, and digital transformation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Infrastructure, and businesses to deliver a secure and efficient digital workplace M365 Environment Management Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, Share Point, One Drive, Intune, etc.). Establish governance, adoption programs, and operational excellence around M365. Oversee administration, configuration, governance, and security of all M365 services. Ensure high availability, performance, and compliance across Exchange Online, Share Point Online, Teams, One Drive, Yammer, and related tools. Stay current with Microsoft roadmaps; recommend adoption strategies for new features. Workforce Device Catalog Own and manage the enterprise laptop/endpoint catalog for Windows, mac OS, and Linux devices. Define baseline configurations with security layer (endpoint protection, disk encryption, patch management, etc.). Partner with IT Security to ensure endpoint compliance and risk mitigation. Mobility Strategy & Software Stack Develop and execute the company’s mobile strategy, balancing productivity with enterprise security. Define and operationalize the corporate mobile software stack (MDM, MAM, secure communications, and productivity apps). VDI Management Own the design and deployment of secure VDI solutions for contractors and external partners. Ensure seamless user experience while meeting data protection standards. Qualifications Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred). 10+ years in IT service delivery, with 5+ years managing M365 teams and services. Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale M365 solutions. Deep expertise in Exchange Online, Teams, Share Point, One Drive, Intune, and Azure AD. Background in mobility strategy, MDM/MAM platforms, and mobile application security. Advanced Power Shell skills for M365 automation and reporting. Experience defining and managing corporate device standards (Windows, mac OS, Linux). Background in mobility strategy, MDM/MAM platforms, and mobile application security. Hands-on experience with VDI deployment and administration.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

title: Lead Analog IC Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About TI
- Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us. Analog Design Engineer (Lead) for Connectivity Products: Connectivity So C’s with Radio & Micro controllers are widely used in Automotive, Industrial and Medical Applications. Some of the examples are BLE based Glucose Monitor patches and Tyre Pressure Monitors; UWB based access control Key Fobs for Cars. We are looking for an Analog Design Lead with complete design cycle experience in Architecture, Design, Schematic, Layout, Verification and So C Integration and Debug. Some of the Analog / Mixed-signal designs that we are exploring include ADC, DAC, PLL, PGA, Filters, Crystal Oscillators, Temperature sensors, LDO, bandgap reference, DC-DC converters, Comparators etc. You will be part of the Central Analog team of Texas Instruments EP BU that is heading the Analog / Mixed-signal designs to be embedded into the So C. In this role, responsibilities may include: Lead an Analog IC design team with product ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications Make assignments for team members, providing design guidance as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives Work with and provide guidance to physical designers and monitors the progress of IC layout Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG Work with systems engineers, application engineers and marketing to prepare product briefs, datasheets, application notes and assisting in the definition of the product to meet customer needs as well as contributing to roadmap formulation and new concept creation Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or TI field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering 6 years of relevant experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Ability to take on challenging problems in analog/mixed-signal development for So C and drive development of innovative solutions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery About Us Why TI? title: Validation Engineering Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. About the job: Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Validation Group in Bangalore, India. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The RF Validation group primarily focusses on the following aspects: Debug of The Transceiver So C: Fast and Systematic Identification of the issues in the blocks. Observe and identify the root cause. Drive solutions and not just report problems. The debug would involve either Power & Biasing issues, Incorrect register sequence or incorrect values, Board level issues etc. RF Measurements : Understanding of each RF, IF and DC measurement. Example in Receiver chain, measurement of Noise Figure & Gain of the chain, Linearity measurements such as P1d B, IIP2, IIP3, IQ gain & Phase error, LO Leakage and DC offsets. DC operating point measurement via Test Mode, DC Voltages and Current Consumption. Similar measurements for TX chain, PLL, Reference Clock. PCB Board Development: Development of PCB Schematic and Layout, PCB material selection, stackup, review the design and implement the changes. Working with 3rd party PCB service companies. Familiarity with Altium and Cadence Allegro flows. Test Automation and Interpretation of Measurements : Person is expected to have proficiency in Coding & Automation of the measurement flows including interfacing of instruments. Processing of the measured data across PVT corners, Visualization, and ability to identify between IC and setup issues. Basic understanding of statistics and sources Interfaces: Ability to deign and program interfaces such as SPI, UART, UCI. title: Lead SOC DFT Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Define testability. Deliver quality. We are looking for a Senior So C DFT Engineer with 4-5 years of experience to join our Connectivity team within the Embedded Processing Division. You will be responsible for implementing and validating DFT strategies throughout the product development cycle, ensuring the testability and quality of our semiconductor designs. You'll work alongside a team of enthusiastic DFT engineers, apply your expertise and deliver robust and reliable products. Qualifications Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Around 4-5 years of experience in DFT, with focus on digital and mixed signal designs. Strong proficiency in DFT tools like Cadence Modus, Genus, etc. Experience with ATPG, scan insertion and test pattern generation for high complexity designs. Hands-on experience with DFT-related EDA tools and methodologies, including scan compression, boundary scan, memory BIST, JTAG, etc. Familiarity with silicon bring-up and post-silicon debug is desirable. Strong knowledge of DFT techniques, methodologies, and industry standards, such as IEEE 1149.1. title: Analog Validation Manager

In this role, you will direct and guide the activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating digital electronic parts, components or integrated circuitry for electronic equipment and other hardware systems. You may also evaluate final results of research and development projects to assure accomplishment of technical objectives. In addition, job functions include preparing and presenting reports outlining the outcome of technical projects and making recommendations for actions necessary to achieve desired results. As a Digital Design Manager, you may also select, develop, and evaluate personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. title: Analog IC Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB): Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB) is an emerging high growth Connectivity technology. Short pulses <3-4ns is used to communicate between a Key Fob and a Car for secure ranging. The short nature of the pulse along with very low duty cycle and advanced data encryption makes it a secure communication approach. Radio operates around microwave frequency band of 7-10GHz and uses 500MHz bandwidth. UWB technology is growing exponentially with Cell Phone Manufacturers such as Apple and Samsung integrating it in the phone and Car OEM’s such as BMW, BYD, Tesla et al integrating UWB based anchors inside car. Besides communication, UWB is perfect for sensing/radar applications. For example, in child safety where UWB based Radar can detect periodic muscle movement such as breathing or general human presence. UWB Radar can also detect various movements around the Car such as kick to open the trunk, an intruder or an occupied seat. About RF Transceiver Group in Connectivity: Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Design group. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The candidate will join in the UWB Design group. Candidate gets to experience Block Architecture Phase, Concept Design and take the design through the various design phases such as Schematic, Layout, Extracted simulations and Test and Verification. The role is primarily in Analog/RF class of circuit design to meet the overall System & Product requirements. The typical blocks include RF blocks such as LNA, TA, Down-conversion Mixers, Base-band filters, High Speed ADC to send data to the Modem. Reverse Chain namely for Transmitter, starting from DAC, Base-band filter, Up-conversion mixer and Power Amplifier stages to drive the TX Pin. LO system design including Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Various Calibration modules (AGC, PDET, Gain, Offset, IQMM, etc) to calibrate the Transceiver chain is part of the design. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage etc. The Design Engineer in RF Connectivity gets introduced to a Holistic view of the product including, Radio Silicon Design, Packaging and PCB and solution design. About the

ROLE:
We are hiring one lead level IC Design Engineer with demonstrated design cycle experience. Some of the possible roles are: PLL & Clock System Design IF filter and VGA Design Transmitter Design Candidate should have gone through 1 complete design cycle of an RF transceiver: namely Architecture, Schematic Design, Layout Design, Tape Out, Test & Validation and identifying design fixes for subsequent Tape Out. description:
Job Description About Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB): Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB) is an emerging high growth Connectivity technology. Short pulses <3-4ns is used to communicate between a Key Fob and a Car for secure ranging. The short nature of the pulse along with very low duty cycle and advanced data encryption makes it a secure communication approach. Radio operates around microwave frequency band of 7-10GHz and uses 500MHz bandwidth. UWB technology is growing exponentially with Cell Phone Manufacturers such as Apple and Samsung integrating it in the phone and Car OEM’s such as BMW, BYD, Tesla et al integrating UWB based anchors inside car. Besides communication, UWB is perfect for sensing/radar applications. For example, in child safety where UWB based Radar can detect periodic muscle movement such as breathing or general human presence. UWB Radar can also detect various movements around the Car such as kick to open the trunk, an intruder or an occupied seat. About RF Transceiver Group in Connectivity: Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Design group. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The candidate will join in the UWB Design group. Candidate gets to experience Block Architecture Phase, Concept Design and take the design through the various design phases such as Schematic, Layout, Extracted simulations and Test and Verification. The role is primarily in Analog/RF class of circuit design to meet the overall System & Product requirements. The typical blocks include RF blocks such as LNA, TA, Down-conversion Mixers, Base-band filters, High Speed ADC to send data to the Modem. Reverse Chain namely for Transmitter, starting from DAC, Base-band filter, Up-conversion mixer and Power Amplifier stages to drive the TX Pin. LO system design including Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Various Calibration modules (AGC, PDET, Gain, Offset, IQMM, etc) to calibrate the Transceiver chain is part of the design. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage etc. The Design Engineer in RF Connectivity gets introduced to a Holistic view of the product including, Radio Silicon Design, Packaging and PCB and solution design. About the

ROLE:
We are hiring one lead level IC Design Engineer with demonstrated design cycle experience. Some of the possible roles are: PLL & Clock System Design IF filter and VGA Design Transmitter Design Candidate should have gone through 1 complete design cycle of an RF transceiver: namely Architecture, Schematic Design, Layout Design, Tape Out, Test & Validation and identifying design fixes for subsequent Tape Out. title: Lead Analog Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us. This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that's continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, mobile computing and communications. Who are we and what do we do? The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions! By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! Senior Analog Design Engineer Location: Bangalore, India Experience: 5+ Years What will you be doing in this role? Analog Chip/Sub-section/IP architect and design with complete ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing. Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications. Providing design guidance to team members as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project. Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives. Work with and provide guidance to physical designers and monitors the progress of IC layout. Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG. Work with systems engineers, application engineers and assisting in the definition of the product to meet customer needs. Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production. Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or TI field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required. Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader. Qualifications Basic Requirements (Must-Haves) Bachelor’s & Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 5+ years of analog circuit design. Preferred Skills & "Good to Have" Active involvement with a customer. Candidate would be expected to interact and collaborate with a sense of ownership with customers and all product development team members including design, layout, systems, verification, validation, test and program management IC system partitioning and architectural tradeoff analysis Block level topology selection, hand analysis, and IC transistor level implementation Schematic generation and simulation on modern CAD tools (Cadence tool set) Worst case identification, top level simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, and simulation data analysis Expertise in tools e.g. Spectre, Simplis, Matlab and AMS System level understanding and analysis; and the ability to translate requirements to an IC spec level Physical layout management, signal grounding and routing tradeoffs, die area optimization Post layout parasitic extraction and simulation, verification of all IC level performance metrics Top level verification, block level modelling, top level simulation Knowledge of device physics and process technologies tradeoffs that are applicable to Power IC design Must budget time, manage schedule and complete complex IC design tasks on time Must have depth of experience and meticulous approach to assure high quality results Must account for limitations of system level specifications, testability, debug, characterization, production and yield targets in the IC design phase. Must work well with colleagues and customers to foster a highly creative, interesting, productive and fun working environment. Organizational Skills: Ability to work well with internal cross functional teams. Must successfully and appropriately interface with external customers. Project management, time management, multi-tasking, problem solving and communication (written and oral) are important skills in this role. Must be able to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision. Team and People Skills: Candidate must be team oriented and must be able to work with TI-internal and external groups (systems, test, sales, marketing, customers, etc.) to resolve issues and generate business success. The ability to work well with others and to perform in a team environment is essential. Projects and Deliverables: The main deliverable is the timely release of meticulously analysed and simulated IC designs or sub-sections of designs for custom designs with tight schedules. These designs should lead to cost-effective, high quality, bug-free products that fully meet our customer’s end-system requirements . About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. description:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us. This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that's continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, mobile computing and communications. Who are we and what do we do? The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions! By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! Senior Analog Design Engineer Location: Bangalore, India Experience: 5+ Years What will you be doing in this role? Analog Chip/Sub-section/IP architect and design with complete ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing. Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications. Providing design guidance to team members as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project. Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives. Work with and provide guidance to physical designers and monitors the progress of IC layout. Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG. Work with systems engineers, application engineers and assisting in the definition of the product to meet customer needs. Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production. Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or TI field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required. Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader. Qualifications Basic Requirements (Must-Haves) Bachelor’s & Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 5+ years of analog circuit design. Preferred Skills & "Good to Have" Active involvement with a customer. Candidate would be expected to interact and collaborate with a sense of ownership with customers and all product development team members including design, layout, systems, verification, validation, test and program management IC system partitioning and architectural tradeoff analysis Block level topology selection, hand analysis, and IC transistor level implementation Schematic generation and simulation on modern CAD tools (Cadence tool set) Worst case identification, top level simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, and simulation data analysis Expertise in tools e.g. Spectre, Simplis, Matlab and AMS System level understanding and analysis; and the ability to translate requirements to an IC spec level Physical layout management, signal grounding and routing tradeoffs, die area optimization Post layout parasitic extraction and simulation, verification of all IC level performance metrics Top level verification, block level modelling, top level simulation Knowledge of device physics and process technologies tradeoffs that are applicable to Power IC design Must budget time, manage schedule and complete complex IC design tasks on time Must have depth of experience and meticulous approach to assure high quality results Must account for limitations of system level specifications, testability, debug, characterization, production and yield targets in the IC design phase. Must work well with colleagues and customers to foster a highly creative, interesting, productive and fun working environment. Organizational Skills: Ability to work well with internal cross functional teams. Must successfully and appropriately interface with external customers. Project management, time management, multi-tasking, problem solving and communication (written and oral) are important skills in this role. Must be able to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision. Team and People Skills: Candidate must be team oriented and must be able to work with TI-internal and external groups (systems, test, sales, marketing, customers, etc.) to resolve issues and generate business success. The ability to work well with others and to perform in a team environment is essential. Projects and Deliverables: The main deliverable is the timely release of meticulously analysed and simulated IC designs or sub-sections of designs for custom designs with tight schedules. These designs should lead to cost-effective, high quality, bug-free products that fully meet our customer’s end-system requirements . About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to us. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. jobDescription:
Job Description Applications engineers for Sitara MPU serve as technical experts on TI’s Sitara family of Processors and its use cases. This function is organized by end equipment and sector to drive a deeper understanding of key Automotive & Industrial markets and enable them to best support our sales team and customers in designing Sitara Processors into their products. Applications engineers will partner with Systems and Marketing teams to deliver system solutions, software, collateral, documentation and tools that accelerate customers' development time and drive design WINs. They also play an important role in ramping new target end-equipment (EE) by showcasing the features of Sitara Processor portfolio in a new context or application. Qualifications Job Description: As a Software Applications Engineering Lead/Manager (Linux focused), you will be responsible for: • Supporting & developing Linux on TI’s latest Arm based So Cs – Understanding of Linux boot flow (SPL, u-boot), BSP, device drivers like (DMA, Flash, serial peripherals, ethernet etc.), good to have an understanding of middleware & frameworks (V4L2, GStreamer, Networking, Graphics etc.) & filesystem distributions (primarily Yocto). • Defining & developing demos to showcase silicon capability & differentiation that helps drive customer engagements. • Working with leading customers for TI Processors in Industrial (HMI, Industrial Automation, Grid Infrastructure, etc.) & Automotive ADAS (DOMS, CMS, Front/Rear/Surround View Camera & Radar, IVI, Cluster and Cockpit) market segments. • Supporting and engaging with customer on TI’s E2E (Engineer to Engineer) forum, online & face to face discussions. • Key point of contact for TI sales and customers, interacting with Systems, Architecture, Software Development, So C Design and Verification teams to facilitate efficient and scalable system architectures for customer use-cases. • Creating collateral like Application Notes, White Papers, Academies and Webinars for enabling a broad customer base. Basic Qualifications • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in ECE or Computer Science. • Minimum 7+ years industry experience in software development on embedded systems. • Deep expertise in developing and supporting Linux on Arm based So Cs with expertise in Industrial or Automotive EEs. • Exposure to leadership roles – Technical Lead or Manager. Skills Required • Strong technical, communication, leadership & management skills along with high level of accountability and curiosity. • Strong background in software, firmware development & experience in programming languages like C, C++ & Python. • Deep expertise in developing and supporting Linux on Arm based So Cs along with experience on heterogeneous So Cs systems – Arm Application & Real time cores, DSP, HW Accelerators etc. • Knowledge of Embedded Systems (MCU, MPU, ARM), Computer Architecture (Cache, DMA, Interconnect) and Operating Systems along with basic communication peripherals (I2C, SPI, UART), Serial Flash and optionally on Camera, Display and High Speed Interfaces like Ethernet, USB, PCIe. • Ability to clearly communicate (via presentations, email, virtual & in-person meetings, etc.) with customers to understand technical requirements and issues. • Strong problem-solving abilities by breaking down complex problems into individual components to debug and correct. • Strongly oriented toward process improvements and agile in achieving success within a constantly evolving environment. • Ability to leverage generative AI to optimize daily workflows. Primary Responsibilities • Technical contribution driven by customer requirement: Develop expertise for key software architecture components to enable product success as measured by time to market. • Team Management (if hired as a manager): Managing a team of 2-5 people; responsible for mentoring, development, planning & execution along with efficient escalation management for key customer projects. • Customer’s technical point of contact: Expert on customer system; voice of customer to drive requirements, schedules, and market direction back into Product’s Software Development. • Ahead of customer requirements in key industrial & automotive segments for TI Sitara Processors: Create benchmarks, software demos, reference designs and self-serve collateral. title: Design Verification Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description We are at a pivotal moment where technology is rapidly evolving, and we have some exciting opportunities within our MCU organization that place us right at the center of this transformation. Our current work is focused on developing solutions for high-growth markets such as AI-driven data centers and emerging domains like humanoid systems. These areas are shaping the future of computing, automation, and intelligent systems, and offer a unique chance to work on cutting-edge technologies with real-world impact. If you are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and want to contribute to innovations in these fast-growing segments, I encourage you to come forward and apply. This is an opportunity to be part of a journey that is not only technically rewarding but also strategically significant. Looking forward to seeing many of you take this step Qualifications Minimum requirements: You will be responsible for driving So C DV and AVn V (Pre/Post silicon, FPGA, Palladium) Support verification/validation leads for power aware verification, GLS, AMS flows, Palladium and FPGA activities RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage & functional) goals Result driven attitude who can work with dynamically evolving requirements Ability to participate and conduct design reviews Ability to mentor the team members Ability drive results from team even without having complete command on domain Good interaction with cross site teams of Digital Design team, s/w team, Analog Designers, and rest of the team Innovate & drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical / Electronics Engineering Minimum of 8+ years of experience Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Ability to support Software & ROM team on silicon bring-up, debug etc Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery About Us Why TI? title: SoC/IP Architect
jobDescription:
responsibilities will include RTL coding, simulation, synthesis, timing closure, verification, evaluation, debugging of high-speed communication chips both at the circuit level and behavioral level. As a design engineer, you will prepare test methods and specifications, assist in preparation of application information, data sheets and demo boards. You will develop solutions to complex problems through assessment of various techniques and approaches. You will plan and organize work to ensure timely completion of many independent tasks with general instructions on routine tasks and with detailed instructions on new assignments. This position involves routine ... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. In this position, you will be working on high-speed mixed-signal communication circuits using state-of-the art process technology, as well as be involved in the design of high performance digital circuits interfacing to leading edge analog circuitry as part of an overall system. Your responsibilities will include RTL coding, simulation, synthesis, timing closure, verification, evaluation, debugging of high-speed communication chips both at the circuit level and behavioral level. As a design engineer, you will prepare test methods and specifications, assist in preparation of application information, data sheets and demo boards. You will develop solutions to complex problems through assessment of various techniques and approaches. You will plan and organize work to ensure timely completion of many independent tasks with general instructions on routine tasks and with detailed instructions on new assignments. This position involves routine communication with a highly talented team of analog and digital design engineers to solve problems and present information as well as active participation in work groups, providing ideas and collaborative teamwork. Qualifications

So C/IP Architect Key Responsibilities Architecture Definition and Design Define and document So C architecture including system topology, IP selection, and integration strategy for complex mixed-signal MCUs Establish Performance, Power, and Area (PPA) targets and drive architectural decisions to meet these goals Design and optimize interconnect architectures including bus structures Perform hardware-software partitioning to optimize functionality across hardware accelerators and software implementations Create architectural models and simulations to validate design decisions early in the development cycle IP Design and Integration Design, customize, or select IP blocks including processors, memory controllers, DSPs, accelerators, and peripherals Ensure IP blocks are reusable, configurable, and scalable across multiple product variants Select and integrate third-party and internal IP cores Define IP specifications and collaborate with IP design teams to ensure requirements are met Optimization and Analysis Analyze and optimize data flow and memory hierarchy to eliminate bottlenecks and maximize system throughput Implement power management strategies and multi-domain power architecture Design security-aware architectures with hardware-based security features, secure boot, and isolation mechanisms Conduct performance analysis and trade-off studies to balance competing requirements Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies for future product roadmaps Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with RTL design, verification, physical design, and software teams to ensure architectural feasibility and successful implementation Support early software bring-up by providing architectural documentation and working models Collaborate with System Job Description Custom Team at Texas Instruments is looking for an experienced, highly driven Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional custom development programs that bring innovative semiconductor products from concept to production. In this role, you will work closely with systems, design, operations, marketing & sales, post-silicon validation, test, quality, and very demanding customer teams to ensure successful execution of schedules, deliverables, and business goals. Key Responsibilities Program Ownership Being in custom development for demanding customers, execution efficacy, timeline adherence, quality control and stakeholder management need to be ensured by the Program Manager. Lead end-to-end program planning, execution, and delivery for analog/mixed-signal/embedded semiconductor products. Drive program scope, timelines, risk assessment, budgeting, and resource planning. Cross-Functional Leadership Coordinate with design, DV, layout, post-Si validation, test engineering, quality, packaging, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing and operations teams across global sites. Facilitate program reviews, technical checkpoints, and decision gates. Schedule & Risk Management Create and maintain detailed program schedules using appropriate tools. Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and ensure teams stay aligned to program objectives. Customer & Stakeholder Communication Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Present program status, key metrics, and critical issues to leadership and customers. Quality & Compliance Ensure programs meet TI’s quality, reliability, and regulatory standards along with customer mandated quality checks. Coordinate root cause analysis and corrective actions when needed. Operational & Business Support Collaborate with product line management on go-to-market strategies. Monitor cost, yield, and performance targets throughout the product lifecycle. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications 5–10+ years of program/project management experience in semiconductors, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing. Experience managing So C/ASIC/analog/mixed-signal or embedded product development programs (depending on team). The ideal candidate will have a strong analog/mixed-signal background, with hands on embedded Flash memory design experience and a deep understanding of underlying device physics. Key

1. Technical Leadership: · Oversee the design, development, and verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits for flash memory development, including charge pumps, voltage regulators, sense amplifiers, and memory interfaces. · Define and review circuit architectures to optimize performance, power, and area (PPA). · Drive innovation in circuit design to address industry challenges in scaling, performance, and reliability for flash. · Provide technical guidance and direction to team members, ensuring timely project execution. · Collaborate with world-wide cross-functional teams, including layout, process, test engineering, and product teams. · Ensure designs meet technical specifications, project timelines, and quality standards. · Identify and mitigate design risks, ensuring robust circuit performance under process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.
2. title: Senior DFT Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description We are seeking talented and motivated individuals to join our team in developing cutting-edge solutions with Application-Specific Microcontrollers (MCUs) for the rapidly evolving automotive industry. Our MCUs power a wide range of critical vehicle functions, including traction control, onboard charging (OBC) and DC-DC converters, advanced lighting systems, body control modules, engine management, and braking systems. Additionally, we are at the forefront of innovation with zonal microcontrollers designed to enable software-defined vehicles, paving the way for greater functionality, scalability, and efficiency. Our products shape the future of automotive technology and create impactful solutions for modern mobility challenges. Position : Senior DFT Design Engineer We are seeking an experienced Senior DFT Design Engineer to join our team in developing advanced automotive microcontroller solutions. The ideal candidate will have extensive expertise in Design for Testability (DFT) for So Cs, with a focus on Scan Insertion/ATPG and Memory Test methodologies. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Define, influence DFT architecture for subsystems and So Cs, achieving automotive-grade Safety and Security standards for logic and memory tests. • Collaborate with IP teams, Systems, and Architecture teams to derive requirements, co-develop microarchitecture, and align DFT goals for IPs, subsystems, and So Cs. • Work closely with Product and Test Engineering teams to understand test needs, provide DFT solutions, debug issues, and optimize test costs. • Partner with cross-functional teams (RTL, DV, PD) to ensure high-quality and timely DFT implementation. Qualifications Qualifications and Skills:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Computer Science (CS), or a related field. Experience : 5-10 years of hands-on experience in DFT aspects of So C Design. Technical Expertise : • Strong understanding of Verilog/VHDL and DFT concepts for testability design. • Proficient in scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, and Python for automation. • Experience with silicon bring-up and debugging. • Familiarity with industry-standard tools like Modus, Genus, Xcelium, and Jasper. • Good understanding of constraints, timing concepts, and test methodologies. Soft Skills : • Excellent problem-solving and debugging capabilities. • Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration and reporting. • Commitment to continuous learning and maintaining a high focus on quality. • Ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in automotive-grade So C designs and compliance with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. • Knowledge of power management techniques and low-power design principles. • Familiarity with advanced automation scripting using Python, Perl, or TCL. title: HW Applications Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. About the job: This role is for a Hardware Applications Manager in the Automotive Body and Chassis Radar business line. The Body and Chassis business line focuses on fast growing and highly visible automotive applications such as in-cabin monitoring, kick-to-open sensing, and door obstacle detection. The Hardware Applications Manager will lead a team responsible for hardware development and customer support, including owning of evaluation kits, reference designs, and ti.com device and application collateral. The manager will be responsible for supporting customers through their entire product lifecycle from the initial engagement process and opportunity exploration, to device evaluation, product development, and quality returns. The manager will also keep track of support activities, monitoring effectiveness and taking action for continuous improvement based on feedback from “engineer-to-engineer” (e2e) forum metrics, quality return cycle time metrics, or direct engagement with field sales and customer partners. The manager will lead a team of applications engineers, translating business goals and objectives into priorities for the team, and also setting expectations back to the leadership team on activities. It will be the responsibility of the manager to determine how to prioritize planned and incoming support, including customer support, support of R&D, and activities intended to help create new engagement opportunities in the market. Developing strategic partnerships, in collaboration with other functions both inside and outside the business line will be important skill for the candidate to demonstrate. This will ensure dependencies are being met to execute on planned development or support activities. This will include partnership with R&D and planning teams on new product execution, but also partnership with systems and marketing teams to scope activities/deliverables needed to meet marketing goals and win new business. Importantly, the manager will also grow the team technically. Identifying and supporting areas for the team to build subject matter expertise, and helping the team grow in capabilities and their “brand” through opportunities like marketing activities, onsite customer support, trade shows, and technical conferences. Key responsibilities include: Ownership of customer support for Body and Chassis Radar business. Customer support includes: Forum and email questions with customer Schematic and Layout reviews of customer applications Debug of customer problems by re-creating issues on TI evaluation boards and/or customer boards On-site support as required Ownership of supporting hardware development for Body and Chassis Radar business including internal and external evaluation kits, application-focused reference designs, and supporting collateral such as evaluation kit guides and customer trainings Setting HW Applications team priorities based on business goals. Tracking and reporting out to leadership on support and development activities. jobDescription:

As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equivale... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking Design Verification Engineer. In this role you will confirm the accuracy of designs for analog and mixed signal electronic parts, components, or integrated circuitry for analog and mixed signal electronic equipment and other hardware systems before pattern generation/mask development. The role will require working independently from the product development team who designed the devices to confirm adherence to known design rules, procedures, and best practices. Additional job functions include analyzing equipment to establish operating data and conducting experimental tests and evaluating results to confirm the device meets all requirements in the specifications. You may also run software simulations, selecting components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equivalent experience in the design of equipment, components or circuitry. About ASM Auto: ASM (Application specific Microcontroller) business powers automotive and industrial MCU across multiple applications. ASM is now working on next generation Automotive MCU platform for all kind of vehicle applications e.g. Traction motor control, Charging, Lighting and Heating control, IC Engine management etc. This platform will churn out multiple differentiated products for Zonal networking in Software defined Vehicles (SDV) and superior real time control for EV Cars. Great opportunity to be part of this grounds up platform development across process nodes, IPs and So Cs. https://www.ti.com/applications/automotive/overview.html

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Complete ownership of IP/subsystem/SOC DV ownership right from spec definition till the post silicon verification and solving the customer issues on need basis. This includes: · Active involvement with architecture team during the spec definition phase · Verification strategy definition along with Verification plan to meet 100% spec to regression traceability along with signoff metrics · Sub System/SOC verification covering functional and Firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL, GLS/PAGLS modes. · DV Environment ownership: TB development/enhancements including checkers and coverage monitor definitions along with DV flow updates as per the project needs · Active collaboration with cross functional teams -Architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, Systems, Analog, FW and application teams -to enable the Verification goals for IP/Subsystem/SOC starting from spec definition till post silicon verification closure activities · Final So C DV signoff based on Regressions, coverage metrics, DV to spec traceability using C and/or SV-UVM adhering to ISO26262 guidelines Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS:
• 2-5 years of DV experience in SS/SOC/Post silicon DV with a Bachelor or Master’s degree in EE/ECE/CS or related specializations Skills: · Experience in one or many of the following: C based SOC DV, scripting (Python/Perl/Shell) knowledge, DV flow ownership for functional/Formal verification, UVM/System Verilog deep understanding, AMS/GLS/PAGLS/CPF/UPF based verification, Post silicon verification etc. · Strong in digital design fundamentals, computer organization & architectures and bus protocols · Excellent debugging skills with Verilog/VHDL designs · Thorough knowledge in one or many of the standard protocols. Ex: AXI, AHB, APB, CAN, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, UART, PSI5, Flexray etc · Work experience on C based environment with ARM/DSP multi-processor-based systems including the power aware simulations is a big plus · Good problem-solving skills · Experience with Cadence tools (Xcelium/v Manager/Formal applications/safety simulator) or similar tools/DV flows · Exposure to CDC DV, Post silicon verification and functional safety is an added advantage · Effective communication skills to interact seamlessly with all stakeholders · Must be highly focused and remain committed to obtaining closure on project goals About Us Why TI? We are looking for passionate, creative and self-driven engineers who would challenge traditional techniques and come up with innovative solutions to make a difference. title: Digital Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world. Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance. These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces and digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Fault handlers & Interrupts etc. This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that’s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics and industrial markets. What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity? To work with the best experts in the industry. To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. To innovate on core technology in design methodologies & influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products & teams. To work on cutting edge industry leading products. To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation & quality of the product. To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business & technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product & technology execution. To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts. To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts. To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities. To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner. To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's/Master's Degree in EE/ECE Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering. 2-5 years of Digital Design experience. Basic Requirement: Strong digital design fundamentals and basic electrical/electronic engineering concepts. Experience in building RTL micro architectures development. Hands on experience in RTL coding. Experience with Verilog/VHDL/System Verilog language. Should be good knowledge on lint, CDC, RDC, constraint development, synthesis. Good understanding of digital timing analysis. Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence). Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl is preferred. Knowledge of audio signal chain, I2C, ASI/TDM, memory architecture and FPGA is preferred. Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill. Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork. Primary

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and Development of digital logic circuits including signal chain, clocking circuits, fault & interrupt handler, memory management and FPGA. Detailed documentation preparation and knowledge sharing of design architecture and implementation with other domains along with conducting Arch and design Reviews Work with analog and firmware design domains on integration of system level specification. Work closely with other design and systems teams to review/close spec gaps and design bugs, as they arise. Handle Design QCs like lint, CDC, RDC Developing constraint development and synthesis. Support physical design team and work closely on timing closure. Support DV and silicon validation team with testplan support, design debugs, root cause analysis and workaround. Review verification coverage and sign off on waivers. Innovate & drive new and improved methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows. Conducting design reviews and creating the necessary design and product documentation. Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis. Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help other team members. Communication of design status, issues, and concerns. Preferred Skills: Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders. Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions. Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Ability to take the initiative and drive for results. Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams. Added Advantage : Experience/know-how in Physical design concepts. Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications. Experience in silicon debug along with silicon validation team. About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Job Description Change the world. Love your job. As a Testing Manager at Texas Instruments, you will lead our newly established Embedded Systems Testing team focused on comprehensive validation of wireless communication technologies, boot ROM, and driver implementations for embedded devices. This leadership role requires deep technical expertise in embedded systems validation combined with proven team management capabilities to drive testing excellence across our Zigbee, Matter, Thread, Wi-SUN protocol stacks, boot ROM implementations and device drivers. You will build and scale a high-performance testing organization from the ground up while ensuring comprehensive coverage of interoperability, compliance, performance, and reliability testing across all embedded system components. Qualifications Minimum requirements: 8+ years of experience in Embedded systems testing Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field Master's degree preferred Experience with hardware debugging tools (JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipeline integration Deep expertise in any of the wireless protocol stacks: Zigbee, Matter, Thread, Wi-SUN

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Technical Expertise Deep expertise in wireless protocol stacks: Extensive hands-on experience with Zigbee, Matter, Thread, Wi-SUN Boot ROM and system initialization: Strong understanding of secure boot processes and system initialization Device driver validation: Experience testing peripheral drivers and hardware abstraction layers Embedded systems mastery: Strong understanding of microcontroller architectures and real-time systems RF and wireless testing: Experience with protocol analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and wireless test equipment Testing methodologies: Expertise in black-box, white-box, integration, system, and automated testing Leadership & Management Skills Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing technical talent Excellent communication skills with ability to present to executive leadership and external partners Technical Tools & Platforms Proficiency with embedded development environments Experience with hardware debugging tools (JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipeline integration Knowledge of version control systems, defect tracking, and test management tools Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Java Script) for test automation Others Knowledge of security testing methodologies for embedded and Io T devices Previous experience in semiconductor or wireless communication industry Understanding of automotive and industrial testing standards Experience with real-time system performance analysis and optimization Primary

title: Software Development Manager - Boot ROM
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. As the Software Development Manager for the Firmware team at Wireless Connectivity Software team at Texas Instruments, you will lead and mentor a talented group of engineers responsible for developing Boot ROM, device and debug support for microcontrollers, embedded drivers, and edge AI solutions. This role requires deep technical expertise in firmware architecture, Boot ROM design, microcontroller initialization, driver development, and edge AI implementation, combined with proven leadership and team management skills. You will drive innovation in system startup, hardware abstraction, debug enablement, and AI integration, ensuring robust and scalable solutions for TI’s next-generation wireless connectivity devices. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred) 8+ years of embedded software/firmware development experience, with at least 3 years in a management or leadership role Proven track record of building and leading technical teams in complex product environments Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Technical Expertise Boot ROM & Firmware: Deep expertise in system initialization, boot loaders, debug support, and ROM reuse strategies Driver Development: Strong background in peripheral drivers (UART, SPI, SD, USB), hardware abstraction layers, device interfaces, and AI-driven driver methodologies Edge AI: Experience with machine learning frameworks for edge devices, model optimization, inference engines, and AI workflow integration Embedded Systems: Comprehensive understanding of microcontroller architectures, RTOS, and boot time optimization Low-level Programming: Mastery of Embedded C and Embedded C++ for resource-constrained environments System Architecture: Experience designing scalable firmware architectures with focus on early boot, debug support, and AI enablement Performance Optimization: Proven ability to optimize boot time, memory footprint, debug capabilities, and AI model efficiency Leadership & Management Skills Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing technical talent Excellent communication skills for executive and cross-functional collaboration Strong project management capabilities with experience delivering complex firmware and AI projects Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery Technical Tools & Platforms Proficiency with embedded development environments and toolchains Experience with hardware debugging tools (JTAG, UARTs, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) Knowledge of version control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), and software quality tools Familiarity with edge AI frameworks (Tensor Flow Lite, ONNX Runtime, TI Deep Learning libraries) Experience with MLOps tools and AI model lifecycle management Familiarity with static analysis and dynamic analysis tools Experience with Python or Perl scripting Preferred Qualifications Work experience in Embedded System Programming (Complete life-cycle) Firmware development and validation as per ROM specification Hands on experience with device drivers like UART, SPI, SD, UFS and USB drivers Product development flows as per Cybersecurity standards and ASPICE processes Understanding of power optimization techniques for embedded systems Experience with RTOS implementations (Free 26262 Experience with MISRA-C, Cert-C guidelines, penetration testing and fuzz testing Strong documentation and writing skills Contributions to open-source projects or industry standard Primary

title: System Engineer
jobDescription:
Responsibilities may include: This role is responsible for product definition for RF clock synthesizers, buffers and BAW oscillators. Systems engineer deeply focus on understanding the technical needs, challenges and future trends of a customer, end equipment, then define new products and innovate forward-looking product roadmap to solve them.
- Systems engineers are typically responsible for supporting a product from conception to release in the area of specification tradeoffs, design reviews, specification compliance, initial customer support and technical en... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Do you want to work for an organization that values your opinion? Do you want to work for an organization where you can play a pivotal role in several different areas? Look no further. As a Texas Instruments (TI) Systems Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work in a vibrant and dynamic team oriented environment with exposure to a variety of state-of-the art applications each day. Responsibilities may include: This role is responsible for product definition for RF clock synthesizers, buffers and BAW oscillators. Systems engineer deeply focus on understanding the technical needs, challenges and future trends of a customer, end equipment, then define new products and innovate forward-looking product roadmap to solve them. Systems engineers are typically responsible for supporting a product from conception to release in the area of specification tradeoffs, design reviews, specification compliance, initial customer support and technical engagement. Research and create new product definitions, including developing business case proposals, product strategies and taking products to release to market System engineer needs to evaluate and prioritize the roadmap parts Identify key end equipment’s and associated product gaps and validate/negotiate with key customers and sales team Develops detailed technical definitions for new products, develop system validation and verification plan and schedules. Work with designers to close the loop with the feedback received from customers and sales throughout the initial development cycle Write the product datasheet specification. Conduct datasheet reviews with application engineers and other stakeholders to ensure completeness of datasheet Perform Trade-offs, understand the competitive landscape Participate in new silicon testing from an systems engineer perspective to ensure robustness of the product. Work with applications engineer to provide support to early design in activities for new products. Work with apps to create custom reference designs targeting relevant applications to be used as customer implementation ideas. Lead and Support whole product launch activities. Work closely with marketing, program management, engineering, apps and validation teams for execution and launch of new products/existing product enhancements. Assess and negotiate IC development tradeoffs with design team and customers Be the technical expert, responsible for product ramp up for the customer Application support for newly introduced and existing products. Develop and provide training for customers and the field teams. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, or related field 2-6 years of relevant experience Experience in hardware board design; schematic capture with any PCB design software Solid hardware debugging skills Strong technical background, with the ability to produce high quality technical documentation Expertise in technical documentation including EVM User's Guide, application notes, design notes and white papers. Good understanding on customer development timelines Schematic and layout review of customer application Strong understanding of analog/mixed-signal IC's and their application Experience promoting/marketing ICs and driving design wins by providing system solutions Strong customer facing skills Familiarity with lab equipment System level circuit modeling with EDA tools, SPICE, Matlab

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Familiarity with signal integrity analysis, power integrity analysis, and EMI/EMC considerations in PCB design Familiar with the use of all necessary lab equipment: oscilloscope, power supplies, gain/phase analyzers, multi-meters, solder station, etc. Experience with hardware/software integration, board bring-up & debug Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Having experience with Clocking related products will be a plus About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to us. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equival... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking Design Verification Engineer. In this role you will confirm the accuracy of designs for analog and mixed signal electronic parts, components, or integrated circuitry for analog and mixed signal electronic equipment and other hardware systems before pattern generation/mask development. The role will require working independently from the product development team who designed the devices to confirm adherence to known design rules, procedures, and best practices. Additional job functions include analyzing equipment to establish operating data and conducting experimental tests and evaluating results to confirm the device meets all requirements in the specifications. You may also run software simulations, selecting components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equivalent experience in the design of equipment, components or circuitry. Qualifications Minimum requirements Minimum education (i.e., bachelor's degree in electrical engineering) Minimum of 3+ years of experience

title: Validation/Characterization Engineer
jobDescription:
required skills in the job are:
1. System Level Understanding of Radio Transceiver: Basic operating principles of Transmit & Receiver chains, Modulation ... Job Description Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Validation Group in Bangalore, India. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The typical transceiver blocks include RF blocks such as LNA, TA, Down-conversion Mixers, Base-band filters, High Speed ADC to send data to the Modem. Reverse Chain namely for Transmitter, starting from DAC, Base-band filter, Up-conversion mixer and Power Amplifier stages to drive the TX Pin. LO system includes Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Various Calibration modules (AGC, PDET, Gain, Offset, IQMM, etc) to calibrate the Transceiver chain is part of the design. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage. The required skills in the job are: System Level Understanding of Radio Transceiver: Basic operating principles of Transmit & Receiver chains, Modulation and system parameters such as PER/BER/SNR and EVM/RMSEE. Debug of the RF Transceiver So C: Fast and Systematic Identification of the issues in the blocks. Observe and identify the root cause. Drive solutions and not just report problems. The debug would involve either Power & Biasing issues, Incorrect register sequence or incorrect values, Board level issues, Semiconductor Process marginalities etc. RF Measurements: Understanding of each RF, IF and DC measurement. Example in Receiver chain, measurement of Noise Figure & Gain of the chain, Linearity measurements such as P1d B, IIP2, IIP3, IQ gain & Phase error, LO Leakage and DC offsets. DC operating point measurement via Test Mode, DC Voltages and Current Consumption. Similar measurements for TX chain, PLL, Reference Clock. PCB Board Development: Development of PCB Schematic and Layout, PCB material selection, stackup, review the design and implement the changes. Working with 3 rd party PCB service companies. Familiarity with Altium and Cadence Allegro flows. Test Automation and Interpretation of Measurements: Person is expected to have proficiency in Coding & Automation of the measurement flows including interfacing of instruments. Processing of the measured data across PVT corners, Visualization and the ability to identify between IC and setup issues. Basic understanding of statistics and sources of error. Interfaces: Ability to design and program interfaces such as SPI, UART, UCI. The candidate is expected to have strong proficiency in 2 or more of the above lists in particular 1-3. A strong team player who is deeply engaged with the Product Development team especially the Radio Design Team. Minimum expected experience is 6 years. Position is on-site in Bangalore. LO system includes Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage. The required skills in the job are: System Level Understanding of Radio Transceiver: Basic operating principles of Transmit & Receiver chains, Modulation and system parameters such as PER/BER/SNR and EVM/RMSEE. The debug would involve either Power & Biasing issues, Incorrect register sequence or incorrect values, Board level issues, Semiconductor Process marginalities etc. RF Measurements: Understanding of each RF, IF and DC measurement.
