jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking an Analog Design Manager. In this role, you will direct and guide the activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating analog and mixed signal electronic parts, components or integrated circuitry for electronic equipment and other hardware systems. You may also evaluate final results of research and development projects to assure accomplishment of technical objectives. In addition, job functions include preparing and presenting reports outlining the outcome of technical projects and making recommendations for actions necessary to achieve desired results. As an Analog Design Manager, you may also select, develop, and evaluate personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. About The Job You will be part of the team with charter to develop new Audio converters catering to PE, Automotive and Industrial market segment. Team has complete charter of end to end development of Audio ADCs, DACs, Codecs including devices with Class D integration. These devices are highly integrated mixed signal devices with on chip digital signal processing capabilities As part of this role you will get opportunity to interface with various engineering teams within the product line including digital design, layout, firmware, verification, validation, test, systems, applications and marketing to successfully execute new products from concept to volume production and subsequent support. You will be a core member in a design team driving flawless execution, while finding innovative design architecture and solutions to customers’ problems through “out of the box thinking” to deliver highly differentiated products. In this role, responsibilities may include: Analog design lead / chip lead of mixed signal audio products with product ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications Make assignments for team members, providing design guidance as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives Work with and provide guidance to physical designers and monitors the progress of IC layout Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG Work with systems engineers, application engineers and marketing to prepare product briefs, datasheets, application notes and assisting in the definition of the product to meet customer needs as well as contributing to roadmap formulation and new concept creation Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or TI field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering > 6 Years of Analog Design experience > 2 Years of hands on experience in Sigma Delta ADC or DAC Knowledge of Clocking (PLL, OSC), Reference, Power Management Designs Experience of leading full project (Chip lead) Or Analog design lead Strong understanding of signal processing, Analog design principles, including low-noise, low-distortion, and high-efficiency circuits Proven record of nurturing talent

title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
jobDescription:
requirements in the specifications. You may also run software simulations, selecting components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equival... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking Design Verification Engineer. In this role you will confirm the accuracy of designs for analog and mixed signal electronic parts, components, or integrated circuitry for analog and mixed signal electronic equipment and other hardware systems before pattern generation/mask development. The role will require working independently from the product development team who designed the devices to confirm adherence to known design rules, procedures, and best practices. Additional job functions include analyzing equipment to establish operating data and conducting experimental tests and evaluating results to confirm the device meets all requirements in the specifications. You may also run software simulations, selecting components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equivalent experience in the design of equipment, components or circuitry. The Ethernet product team (part of High Speed Data Org) at Texas Instruments' Bangalore site designs and delivers advanced Ethernet PHY devices, serving critical Industrial (Std.) and Automotive applications. The team has a track record of delivering successful family of products catering to 10Mbps,100Mbps, 1Gbps for both Standard Ethernet and Single pair Ethernet (SPE) for Automotive standards. The DSP data path is at the core of the Ethernet PHY and implements the functions of equalization, echo cancellation, data recovery and symbol timing recovery. Crucial for a stable connection, Ethernet PHY training necessitates the challenging joint convergence of various feedback loops inside the DSP. The design team drives innovation in design and digital verification (DV), leading to robust link performance metrics such as link up time, link stability, BER. The team also develops the architecture for, and efficiently implements, Forward Error Correction (FEC) schemes (Viterbi algorithm, Reed-Solomon (RS) decoding). Furthermore, the team specializes in implementing solutions that ensure robust electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) performance. Job Description : We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Design Verification (DV) Engineer to join the High-Speed Data (Ethernet) development team. The ideal candidate will lead chip-level DV, that requires creating test benches, simulation and validation of complex systems in which the signal processing (DSP) data path is the core component. He / She will lead and participate in Module level DV using Matlab generated vectors, DUT level DV and system level DV involving 2 or more DUTs. He / She will lead the Analog and channel model development for FPGA emulation. This involves (i) Coming up with suitable architecture for building synthesizable channel models, (ii) Bringing up the FPGA synthesis and (iii) Verify design as well as system performance (BER, SNR etc.) in FPGA platforms and automate DV regressions and the analysis of results. He / She will closely work with the digital and analog design team members in pre-silicon verification of next-generation products. Towards the end of the PG cycle, he will bring up the GLS to sign off and to estimate digital power consumption. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Study specifications, review design (RTL) to come up with test-cases for coverage. Develop test-benches for Module level, DUT level and system level verification. Own critical features, Lead the debug effort to ensure quality. Work on FPGA-based emulation / prototyping for design validation and performance evaluation. Lead the Synthesizable Modeling effort for Analog & Channel Models. Analyze simulation/emulation results and provide insights to improve design quality. Document models, assumptions, and results clearly. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Minimum education (i.e., bachelor's degree in electrical engineering) Minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
2–5 years of experience in DV, system modeling (analog / mixed-signal modelling). Understanding of digital design concepts. Good programming skills in Verilog, Matlab, Python. Good Fundamentals in DSP concepts (filters, signal processing, sampling, modulation, adaptive filters etc.) is preferred. Exposure to FPGA based emulation is preferred. Personal Attributes : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and documentation skills. Ability to work in cross-functional teams. The Radar Firmware group in Bangalore is seeking a talented and experienced Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our team developing cutting-edge, safety-certified firmware for TI's industry-leading mm Wave Radar portfolio. title: Physical Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world. Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance. These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces and digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Fault handlers & Interrupts etc. This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that’s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics and industrial markets. What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity? To work with the best experts in the industry. To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. To innovate on core technology in design methodologies & influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products & teams. To work on cutting edge industry leading products. To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation & quality of the product. To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business & technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product & technology execution. To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts. To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts. To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities. To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner. To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns. Qualifications Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's/Master's Degree in EE/ECE Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering. 1-2 years of Digital Design experience. Basic Requirement: Strong digital design fundamentals and basic electrical/electronic engineering concepts. Experience in building RTL micro architectures development. Hands on experience in RTL coding. Experience with Verilog/VHDL/System Verilog language. Should be good knowledge on lint, CDC, RDC, constraint development, synthesis. Good understanding of digital timing analysis. Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence). Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl is preferred. Knowledge of audio signal chain, I2C, ASI/TDM, memory architecture and FPGA is preferred. Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill. Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork. Primary

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and Development of digital logic circuits including signal chain, clocking circuits, fault & interrupt handler, memory management and FPGA. Detailed documentation preparation and knowledge sharing of design architecture and implementation with other domains along with conducting Arch and design Reviews Work with analog and firmware design domains on integration of system level specification. Work closely with other design and systems teams to review/close spec gaps and design bugs, as they arise. Handle Design QCs like lint, CDC, RDC Developing constraint development and synthesis. Support physical design team and work closely on timing closure. Support DV and silicon validation team with testplan support, design debugs, root cause analysis and workaround. Review verification coverage and sign off on waivers. Innovate & drive new and improved methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows. Conducting design reviews and creating the necessary design and product documentation. Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis. Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help other team members. Communication of design status, issues, and concerns. Preferred Skills: Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders. Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions. Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Ability to take the initiative and drive for results. Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams. Added Advantage: Experience/know-how in Physical design concepts. Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications. Experience in silicon debug along with silicon validation team. About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. title: Software Engineering Manager
jobDescription:
Responsibilities Technical Leadership • Lead development of audio algorithms including (but not limited to): • Equalization, Dynamic Range Control (DRC), loudness management • Speaker protection • Spatial audio, stereo widening, crosstalk cancellation • Noise suppression • Psychoacoustic tuning and perceptual optimization • Drive algorithm performance under real-time, low-power, and fixed-point constraints. • Guid... Job Description About the Role We are looking for an Audio Algorithm Development Manager to lead the design and deployment of high-performance audio algorithms for next-generation of audio enabled multimedia platforms. This role combines audio/DSP expertise with people leadership, owning audio algorithm development from concept and modeling through validation and product release. You will work at the heart of audio solutions balancing audio quality, latency, power, and compute constraints, while collaborating closely with hardware, firmware, and product teams. ⸻ Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership • Lead development of audio algorithms including (but not limited to): • Equalization, Dynamic Range Control (DRC), loudness management • Speaker protection • Spatial audio, stereo widening, crosstalk cancellation • Noise suppression • Psychoacoustic tuning and perceptual optimization • Drive algorithm performance under real-time, low-power, and fixed-point constraints. • Guide modeling, simulation, and objective/perceptual evaluation of audio quality. • Review and approve algorithm architectures, trade-offs, and optimizations. ⸻ Team & People Management • Build, manage, and mentor a team of audio algorithm engineers. • Set technical direction and enforce best practices in DSP design and implementation. • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and performance evaluations. • Support career growth and technical depth within the team. ⸻ Cross-Functional Collaboration • Work closely with architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and silicon validation. • Collaborate with product management and OEM partners on audio requirements and tuning targets. • Support post-silicon bring-up, debugging, and field issue resolution. Execution & Delivery • Own audio algorithm roadmaps, schedules, and risk assessments. • Ensure on-time delivery of production-ready audio algorithms. • Drive documentation, IP reuse, and scalability across product generations. Why Join Us • Lead audio innovation that ships in millions of consumer devices. • Work at the intersection of acoustics, DSP, and silicon. • Influence product direction from early architecture to final tuning. • Collaborative, engineering-driven culture with strong growth opportunities Qualifications Required Qualifications • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Acoustics, or related field. • 8+ years of experience in audio algorithm or DSP development for embedded or semiconductor systems. • 2+ years of experience in technical leadership or people management. • Strong foundation in digital signal processing and audio fundamentals. • Hands-on experience with fixed-point implementation and real-time constraints. • Proficiency with MATLAB, Python, and C/C++ for algorithm development and validation. ⸻ Preferred Qualifications • Ph D / Masters in Audio DSP, Acoustics, or related discipline. • Experience with mobile, laptop, wearable, automotive, or smart speaker audio systems. • Familiarity with objective and subjective audio evaluation methods. • Experience with So C audio pipelines, DSP cores, or hardware accelerators. • Exposure to audio interfaces like I2S, TDM, Soundwire, Slimbus etc. ⸻ Key Skills • Audio DSP & psychoacoustics • Algorithm optimization under power and memory constraints • Fixed-point and real-time system design • Technical leadership and mentoring • Cross-functional communication • Audio quality tuning and validation About Us Why TI? title: Design Verification Manager
jobDescription:
responsibilities include designing low-power So C architectures, hardware accelerators, safety and security infrastructure, and application-specific control and communication peripherals. They also oversee the integration of these IPs into So Cs, along with implementation, tape-out, and post-silicon release-to-market enablement. As a Verification Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced MSP products... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. The MSP design team, part of Embedded Processing (EP), develops cutting-edge system-on-chips (So Cs) that are affordable and ultra-low-power, featuring integrated high-performance digital and analog peripherals for a wide range of applications in the industrial, automotive, and embedded sectors. The team is responsible for architecting and developing differentiated intellectual properties (IPs) and So Cs that minimize power consumption while delivering superior analog and computing performance. The team’s responsibilities include designing low-power So C architectures, hardware accelerators, safety and security infrastructure, and application-specific control and communication peripherals. They also oversee the integration of these IPs into So Cs, along with implementation, tape-out, and post-silicon release-to-market enablement. As a Verification Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced MSP products. Your duties will include verifying IPs, So C designs, and assisting with customer debugging, while also contributing to the development of robust verification methodologies and strategies in accordance with ISO 26262/ISO 21434 standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
End-to-End ownership of IP/subsystem/SOC DV/Post silicon debugs ownership right from spec definition till the post silicon verification and solving the customer issues. This includes: Technical: Actively collaborate with the architecture team during the specification definition phase. Define the verification strategy along with a plan to ensure 100% traceability between specifications and regression, including standard signoff metrics. Conduct IP, Sub System, and So C verification, covering both functional and firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL and GLS/PAGLS modes. IP/SS/SOC verification covering functional and Firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL, GLS/PAGLS modes. Own the DV environment, which includes defining and developing test benches, enhancing UVC integration, updating checkers and coverage monitors, and adapting the DV flow as needed for the project. Proficient in analog and mixed-signal (AMS) verification, clock domain crossing (CDC) digital verification, formal verification, and post-silicon verification. Work closely with cross-functional teams
- including Architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, Systems, Analog, Firmware, and Application teams
- to achieve verification goals for IP, subsystem, and So C from specification definition through to post-silicon verification closure. Provide final So C DV signoff based on regression results, coverage metrics, and DV to specification traceability using C and/or SV-UVM, while adhering to ISO 26262/ISO 21434 guidelines. Actively participate in customer reviews and certification processes (ISO 26262/ISO 21434). Qualifications Minimum requirements:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in EE/EC/EI/CS, or related specializations. Experience: A minimum of 8-12 years in relevant fields. Preferred Skillset: Experience in C-based System-on-Chip (So C) design verification (DV), with exposure to firmware verification and deep understanding of UVM/System Verilog, Specman, GLS/PAGLS/UPF based verification, post-silicon verification, etc. Proficient in scripting languages such as Perl and Python, and knowledgeable in AI/ML-based DV. In-depth understanding of various standard protocols, including AHB, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, USB. Work experience in a C-based environment involving ARM systems, particularly with power-aware simulations, is a significant advantage. Strong grasp of digital design fundamentals, computer organization and architecture, and bus protocols. Excellent debugging skills with Verilog and VHDL designs. Solid problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Cadence tools (such as Xcelium, v Manager, Formal JG applications, and safety simulators) or similar tools and DV flows. Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, enabling the development of strong relationships and seamless interaction with key internal and external stakeholders. Proven ability to manage, lead, and collaborate with cross-functional teams while taking the initiative to drive projects forward. Familiarity with functional safety and cybersecurity processes Proactively improve daily operations by keeping up with the latest technical trends and actively participating in both internal and external technology forums and conferences. Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills to effectively address complex problems and navigate organizational challenges. Quickly adapt to new systems and processes while managing time effectively to ensure on-time delivery. About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. title: Device Modeling Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About TI Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! About the Job Join TI's elite SPICE Modeling Group and drive cutting-edge semiconductor innovation. You'll extract and optimize compact (SPICE) models for next-generation devices while collaborating with world-class engineers across analog, digital, and mixed-signal design and process technology teams. This position is based in TI's Bangalore, India office. What You'll Do: Extract compact models for advanced semiconductor devices (MOS, LDMOS, DEMOS, BJT, Passives, Ga N, RF, Sensors, NVM, RAM) Partner with designers and technologists to deploy modeling solutions for breakthrough circuit topologies Develop innovative model formulations for emerging device technologies Automate modeling infrastructure to accelerate technology development Develop AI/ML-enhanced models and parameter extraction methodologies Validate models through comprehensive measurement and analysis The person performing this role must be capable to plan effectively, drive schedules, meet critical deadlines on multiple tasks in parallel, lead technical discussions in their area of expertise, and work effectively across organizational boundaries. They must be able to clearly communicate project status and actions. Additionally, they must be able to interface with multiple organizations and work well on a diverse team to accomplish goals. Why This Role Matters: Your modeling expertise will directly impact TI's next-generation products, from automotive to industrial to embedded applications. You will work at the intersection of process, device physics, and circuit design, solving complex challenges and delivering cutting edge solutions. Ready to model the future? Apply today. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or related field 5+ years in compact (SPICE) modeling and semiconductor technology

Job Description Job Description: This role is responsible for product engineering support for RF clock synthesizers, buffers, jitter cleaners and BAW oscillators. Key responsibility is to own the manufacturability, quality and reliability of devices: Collaborate and work in a team environment with Design, Test, Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability in all aspects of new product development, production release to accomplish goals and objectives. Perform evaluation, debug and characterization of integrated circuits to ensure they meet specifications/requirements. Work with failure analysis (FA) to determine root causes of any reliability and qualification failures. Knowledge of board designing and analyzing large amounts of characterization data for yield analysis and test limits. title: Analog ESD Product Specialist
jobDescription:
qualification; yielding a platform for strong interaction with technology development, product, and reliability groups. The primary purpose of the Analog ESD Product Specialist is to improve design quality and eliminate unwanted design iterations caused by ESD-induced failures, while continually improving ESD protection effectiveness and area efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Design, develop and implement ESD protection s... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. As an Analog ESD Product Specialist, you will have the opportunity to work with TI’s industry-leading analog products for precision analog, power management, imaging, audio, high-speed converter and interface applications. You will be exposed to a variety of technologies from deep-submicron, analog CMOS, to high-voltage Bi CMOS. This position provides an excellent view of the entire commercial semiconductor flow from technology development to productization support and circuit design, to product qualification; yielding a platform for strong interaction with technology development, product, and reliability groups. The primary purpose of the Analog ESD Product Specialist is to improve design quality and eliminate unwanted design iterations caused by ESD-induced failures, while continually improving ESD protection effectiveness and area efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design, develop and implement ESD protection structures for analog products using TI’s analog processes Perform ESD reviews on TI analog products Perform ESD troubleshooting on TI analog products that fail internal, or customer, qualification requirements. Assist with the design and development of test structures for ESD assessment of TI’s analog process technologies. Maintain ESD protection structure libraries and ESD design guideline documents to be used by TI design engineers and I/O cell developers. The ideal candidate will have a Ph.D. with 3 years of experience or MSEE with 5 years of experience in the field of Analog ESD Design support. As an Analog ESD Product Specialist, you will be expected to have a strong understanding of the following: Analog and digital circuit operation Diode, resistor, bipolar and FET high current device physics Typical CMOS and Analog silicon process flows and the underlying process physics High Voltage ESD Design (>20V) Additionally, strong “hands-on” lab experience and excellent problem solving skills are a must. This position requires a high level of attention to details and self-organization. It is extremely important to be self-directed, pro-active, and innovative. You must have both the ability to manage multiple tasks within a single job and the ability to manage multiple jobs, to meet required deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential. Qualifications Minimum requirements: The ideal candidate will have a Ph.D. with 3 years of experience or MSEE with 5 years of experience in the field of Analog ESD Design support.

- Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Analog Design Engineer (Lead) for Connectivity Products: Connectivity So C’s with Radio & Micro controllers are widely used in Automotive, Industrial and Medical Applications. Some of the examples are BLE based Glucose Monitor patches and Tyre Pressure Monitors; UWB based access control Key Fobs for Cars. We are looking for an Analog Design Lead with complete design cycle experience in Architecture, Design, Schematic, Layout, Verification and So C Integration and Debug. Some of the Analog / Mixed-signal designs that we are exploring include ADC, DAC, PLL, PGA, Filters, Crystal Oscillators, Temperature sensors, LDO, bandgap reference, DC-DC converters, Comparators etc. You will be part of the Central Analog team of Texas Instruments EP BU that is heading the Analog / Mixed-signal designs to be embedded into the So C. requirements from multiple business applications into the software SDK and Security architecture, deliv... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) Radar Software Team is looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer
- Radar SDK Lead to join our team. At TI Radar Software Team, our Software Developers architect, design, develop, modify, debug and evaluate embedded programs for variety of Radar SOC devices. You will lead and mentor a dynamic engineering team, architect, design, and analyze existing solutions while developing innovative algorithms for new generation SOC devices; coding and testing/debugging programs. You will develop conversion and system implementation plans, prepare system and programming documentation as per software development process. This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of TI's Radar technology portfolio while leading breakthrough innovations in autonomous systems and industrial sensing applications. This role will integrate requirements from multiple business applications into the software SDK and Security architecture, delivering accurate, scalable, user-friendly SW solutions. Role also provides opportunities to gain high visibility into all layers of the radar organization, including Business managers, Application team, Systems architecture, SOC design team and ROM Firmware development teams. Opportunity to work with a strong technical team to learn, innovative and develop solutions in support of a rapidly changing business environment. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will directly impact millions of vehicles and industrial systems worldwide, contributing to safer autonomous driving and smarter industrial automation. In this role you will: Lead and mentor team of 2-3 engineers in the SDK team in developing peripheral drivers, SBL, security drivers and radar signal processing algorithms for multiple Radar Devices like 3 rd and 2nd gen device families. Lead Radar SDK development starting from pre-silicon execution till RTM. Drive the planning, architecture, design, development, and testing of complex drivers and Radar algorithms associated with Radar SW SDK Lead and drive HSM runtime security software requirements gathering, design, architecture and development. Debug and enhance existing software solutions Apply deep expertise in embedded systems, coding and application use cases Collaborate with business to develop requirements and create level of effort estimates Develop solutions following software development process and best practice methodologies Mentor junior team members and lead/drive assigned projects with higher responsibilities. Develop automations and use AI/ML tools to enhance the execution efficiency Partner with businesses, R&D and program management to develop entitlement around solutions (training, work sessions, Planning) Analyze and resolve customer and internal issues being encountered by the team and global end user community. About the organization: In Radar BU, we develop mm-wave (60GHz and 77Hz) chips for automotive and industrial applications. Our mm-wave radar chips are critical in enabling a broad spectrum of high-tech use-cases, such as, environment sensing for autonomous and assisted driving of vehicles (ADAS functionalities), in-cabin sensing for seat-belt alerts and child-left-behind alerts, people sensing for indoor lighting and temperature control, human gesture sensing in intelligent gadgets, and sensing for robotics in factories, smart-homes and buildings. Our complex radar transceivers and systems-on-chip are an outcome of cutting-edge R&D across multiple disciplines (winner and 3-time finalist at Jack Kilby Award of Innovation ), meticulous collaboration of our brightest and diligent analog, digital, systems, test, validation, packaging, and software technologists, as well as sophisticated measurement labs and sustained backing from TI leadership. These multi-core chips include high-end mm-wave amplifiers, PLLs, data convertors, signal processing and cryptography accelerators, processors, memories, AI/ML algorithms, built-in-self-tests, functional safety hardware and software, and power management, and have extremely challenging power, cost and performance specifications. Radar BU is an emerging one and one of the fastest growing businesses in Embedded Processors. Join us in accelerating this exciting growth journey! title: ESD Lead
jobDescription:
qualification; yielding a platform for strong interaction with technology development, product, and reliability groups. The primary purpose of the Analog ESD Product Specialist is to improve design quality and eliminate unwanted design iterations caused by ESD-induced failures, while continually improving ESD protection effectiveness and area efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Design, develop and implement ESD protection s... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. As an Analog ESD Product Specialist, you will have the opportunity to work with TI’s industry-leading analog products for precision analog, power management, imaging, audio, high-speed converter and interface applications. You will be exposed to a variety of technologies from deep-submicron, analog CMOS, to high-voltage Bi CMOS. This position provides an excellent view of the entire commercial semiconductor flow from technology development to productization support and circuit design, to product qualification; yielding a platform for strong interaction with technology development, product, and reliability groups. The primary purpose of the Analog ESD Product Specialist is to improve design quality and eliminate unwanted design iterations caused by ESD-induced failures, while continually improving ESD protection effectiveness and area efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design, develop and implement ESD protection structures for analog products using TI’s analog processes Perform ESD reviews on TI analog products Perform ESD troubleshooting on TI analog products that fail internal, or customer, qualification requirements. Assist with the design and development of test structures for ESD assessment of TI’s analog process technologies. Maintain ESD protection structure libraries and ESD design guideline documents to be used by TI design engineers and I/O cell developers. The ideal candidate will have a Ph.D. with 10 years of experience or MSEE with 15 years of experience in the field of Analog ESD Design support. As an Analog ESD Product Specialist, you will be expected to have a strong understanding of the following: Analog and digital circuit operation Diode, resistor, bipolar and FET high current device physics Typical CMOS and Analog silicon process flows and the underlying process physics High Voltage ESD Design (>20V) Additionally, strong “hands-on” lab experience and excellent problem solving skills are a must. This position requires a high level of attention to details and self-organization. It is extremely important to be self-directed, pro-active, and innovative. You must have both the ability to manage multiple tasks within a single job and the ability to manage multiple jobs, to meet required deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential. Job Description About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Software Architect to lead the transformation of our legacy Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Transportation Management Systems (TMS) across our global supply chain operations. Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us. Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to grow, innovate, take an active role in solving controller & Power stage technical challenges, create novel reference material for various CPU/ASIC power solutions, provide top-notch applications support to customers for various applications, defining next Gen multiphase controller & Power stage for Enterprise Computing/Datacenter market. This is a fast paced, results driven environment that requires broad knowledge, creativity and excellent interpersonal skills on a daily basis. They then collaborate with the full IC development team (design, test, product engineers) to deliver products to the market which are compelling, competitive, cost-conscious, manufacturable, and importantly, successful in growing TI's business In this role, you will be part of a strong and fast-moving team with opportunities to: Design and build evaluation modules for Multiphase Controller & Power stage Deeply involvement in the new product development with cutting edge of new Gen CPU/AI server power architecture. Assess IC development tradeoff with design team and creating competition benchmarking. jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. About TI Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. In TI’s Power Products, we’re developing breakthrough technology to power the world’s future innovations as well. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP): Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and data centers are just a few of the trends driving the need for high-current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise market. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market the multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions for enterprise computing and other ASICs that are power hungry and require very high currents (can be 1000A+). The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level. About the job At TI, Test Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Test Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are cost-wise optimized. The MPP product line is working on complex multiphase buck controllers and the world’s breakthrough technology to develop the high-power density power stages. About the role and team: Work with the design team to understand design specifications and system challenges Generate test plan, create test and char program, design ATE hardware interface boards Debug characterizing silicon on ATE, and correlate results with bench data Analyze silicon results, supporting failure analysis tasks Perform statistical analysis of yield fallout, debug and fix yield issues; optimize test time Work with the production team to release products to volume production Test strategy definition and implementation for multiphase controller and power stage devices Silicon qualification, including the qual program development Comprehensive device debugging, design validation, and failure analysis Drive for robust and cost-effective test solutions while being accountable for product quality Work with the design and Firmware team to support customer needs, implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and validation teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW level workaround for the fix. Engaging with customers with application engineers, to help them understand the device better, help to fix the issues, and provide modifications if any tweaks are needed. This is done in collaboration with Application engineers. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 5+ years of relevant experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience: Greater than 5 years Strong fundamentals in electronics: RC networks, operational amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, DC-DC buck converters Experience to define the test flow, test list and plan to create a test-architecture strategy. title: Validation/Characterization Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Validation engineers are said to have a 'break-the-part' mentality. This means they spend some of their time working to identify the use-cases in which the device will stop working as intended and understand the impact and cause of those failures. Sometimes, those are acceptable failures, but others we may need to mitigate for quality, safety, or other reasons. Plus, we want to ensure that our parts are consistently performing to the specifications that we set in our data sheet, and even to some more conservative limits or as defined in the VVCM (validation/verification compliance matrix). To do this, they must design PCB boards and develop automation software that will increase coverage and reduce data collection time. Validation engineers will also design, develop, and implement necessary methods of measuring device performance and troubleshooting any related systems, equipment or device issues that arise. Validation engineers are often working in a post-silicon lab or on the software programs required to run their measurements. Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP): Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Autonomous Driving are just a few of the trends driving the need for high current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise, Data Center, Communications and Automotive markets. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market driverless multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions to attach to enterprise computing and other ASICs that require currents from 100A to greater than 1000A. The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level. About the job At TI, Validation Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Validation Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are technically and cost-wise optimized. The MPP product line is working on complex multiphase buck controllers and the world’s breakthrough technology to develop high-power density power stages. The validation engineer in MPP has to evaluate the system-level performace also for enterprise computing. About the role and team: Develop validation board, schematics and layout, matching it with customer use-case & applications. The validation boards include
- modularization of the Val board for generic flow, solving mixed-signal challenges, scalability of HW for a large number of setups and most importantly closeness to the customer EVMs. Build, design, and document the full validation plan. The validation plan needs a detailed understanding of not only the device but also the system environment. Define the Validation Strategy in terms of Hardware, Software and Instrumentation Building Validation test cases and implementing them on different scripting languages. (i.e. Python, Test stand, lab view etc) Define, build the automation strategies and implement them through methodology, circuit, script and hardware innovations. Bring the device on the bench; Perform system level and parametric test on the bench with a strong break-the-part mentality. Work with design and Firmware team to support customer needs, and implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and application teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW-level workaround for the fix. Debug device and setup-related issues and drive the issue to closure independently Engaging on customer issues and fixes with application engineers, to help them understand the device better, help to fix the issues and provide modifications if any tweaks are needed. This is done in collaboration with Application engineers. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 5+ years of relevant experience

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience in validation engineering of analog products Demonstrates hardware debugging skills, schematic and PCB layout design. description:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. Validation engineers are said to have a 'break-the-part' mentality. This means they spend some of their time working to identify the use-cases in which the device will stop working as intended and understand the impact and cause of those failures. Sometimes, those are acceptable failures, but others we may need to mitigate for quality, safety, or other reasons. Plus, we want to ensure that our parts are consistently performing to the specifications that we set in our data sheet, and even to some more conservative limits or as defined in the VVCM (validation/verification compliance matrix). To do this, they must design PCB boards and develop automation software that will increase coverage and reduce data collection time. Validation engineers will also design, develop, and implement necessary methods of measuring device performance and troubleshooting any related systems, equipment or device issues that arise. Validation engineers are often working in a post-silicon lab or on the software programs required to run their measurements. Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP): Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Autonomous Driving are just a few of the trends driving the need for high current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise, Data Center, Communications and Automotive markets. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market driverless multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions to attach to enterprise computing and other ASICs that require currents from 100A to greater than 1000A. The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level. About the job At TI, Validation Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Validation Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are technically and cost-wise optimized. The MPP product line is working on complex multiphase buck controllers and the world’s breakthrough technology to develop high-power density power stages. The validation engineer in MPP has to evaluate the system-level performace also for enterprise computing. About the role and team: Develop validation board, schematics and layout, matching it with customer use-case & applications. The validation boards include
- modularization of the Val board for generic flow, solving mixed-signal challenges, scalability of HW for a large number of setups and most importantly closeness to the customer EVMs. Build, design, and document the full validation plan. The validation plan needs a detailed understanding of not only the device but also the system environment. Define the Validation Strategy in terms of Hardware, Software and Instrumentation Building Validation test cases and implementing them on different scripting languages. (i.e. Python, Test stand, lab view etc) Define, build the automation strategies and implement them through methodology, circuit, script and hardware innovations. Bring the device on the bench; Perform system level and parametric test on the bench with a strong break-the-part mentality. Work with design and Firmware team to support customer needs, and implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and application teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW-level workaround for the fix. Debug device and setup-related issues and drive the issue to closure independently Engaging on customer issues and fixes with application engineers, to help them understand the device better, help to fix the issues and provide modifications if any tweaks are needed. This is done in collaboration with Application engineers. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 5+ years of relevant experience

title: Validation/Characterization Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Validation Group in Bangalore, India. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The RF Validation group primarily focusses on the following aspects: Debug of The Transceiver So C: Fast and Systematic Identification of the issues in the blocks. Observe and identify the root cause. Drive solutions and not just report problems. The debug would involve either Power & Biasing issues, Incorrect register sequence or incorrect values, Board level issues etc. RF Measurements : Understanding of each RF, IF and DC measurement. Example in Receiver chain, measurement of Noise Figure & Gain of the chain, Linearity measurements such as P1d B, IIP2, IIP3, IQ gain & Phase error, LO Leakage and DC offsets. DC operating point measurement via Test Mode, DC Voltages and Current Consumption. Similar measurements for TX chain, PLL, Reference Clock. PCB Board Development: Development of PCB Schematic and Layout, PCB material selection, stackup, review the design and implement the changes. Working with 3rd party PCB service companies. Familiarity with Altium and Cadence Allegro flows. Test Automation and Interpretation of Measurements : Person is expected to have proficiency in Coding & Automation of the measurement flows including interfacing of instruments. Processing of the measured data across PVT corners, Visualization, and ability to identify between IC and setup issues. Basic understanding of statistics and sources Interfaces: Ability to deign and program interfaces such as SPI, UART, UCI. Qualifications Minimum requirements: Minimum education (ie bachelor's degree in electrical engineering) 2+years of experience with RF validation and debug of RF IPs Understanding of Rf systems and key instruments The candidate is expected to have proficiency in 2 or more of the list. title: Analog Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB): Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB) is an emerging high growth Connectivity technology. Short pulses <3-4ns is used to communicate between a Key Fob and a Car for secure ranging. The short nature of the pulse along with very low duty cycle and advanced data encryption makes it a secure communication approach. Radio operates around microwave frequency band of 7-10GHz and uses 500MHz bandwidth. UWB technology is growing exponentially with Cell Phone Manufacturers such as Apple and Samsung integrating it in the phone and Car OEM’s such as BMW, BYD, Tesla et al integrating UWB based anchors inside car. Besides communication, UWB is perfect for sensing/radar applications. For example, in child safety where UWB based Radar can detect periodic muscle movement such as breathing or general human presence. UWB Radar can also detect various movements around the Car such as kick to open the trunk, an intruder or an occupied seat. About RF Transceiver Group in Connectivity: Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Design group. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The candidate will join in the UWB Design group. Candidate gets to experience Block Architecture Phase, Concept Design and take the design through the various design phases such as Schematic, Layout, Extracted simulations and Test and Verification. The role is primarily in Analog/RF class of circuit design to meet the overall System & Product requirements. The typical blocks include RF blocks such as LNA, TA, Down-conversion Mixers, Base-band filters, High Speed ADC to send data to the Modem. Reverse Chain namely for Transmitter, starting from DAC, Base-band filter, Up-conversion mixer and Power Amplifier stages to drive the TX Pin. LO system design including Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Various Calibration modules (AGC, PDET, Gain, Offset, IQMM, etc) to calibrate the Transceiver chain is part of the design. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage etc. The Design Engineer in RF Connectivity gets introduced to a Holistic view of the product including, Radio Silicon Design, Packaging and PCB and solution design. About the

ROLE:
We are hiring one lead level IC Design Engineer with demonstrated design cycle experience. Some of the possible roles are: PLL & Clock System Design IF filter and VGA Design Transmitter Design ADC Design Candidate should have gone through 1 complete design cycle of an RF transceiver: namely Architecture, Schematic Design, Layout Design, Tape Out, Test & Validation and identifying design fixes for subsequent Tape Out. description:
Job Description About Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB): Ultra-Wide-Band (UWB) is an emerging high growth Connectivity technology. Short pulses <3-4ns is used to communicate between a Key Fob and a Car for secure ranging. The short nature of the pulse along with very low duty cycle and advanced data encryption makes it a secure communication approach. Radio operates around microwave frequency band of 7-10GHz and uses 500MHz bandwidth. UWB technology is growing exponentially with Cell Phone Manufacturers such as Apple and Samsung integrating it in the phone and Car OEM’s such as BMW, BYD, Tesla et al integrating UWB based anchors inside car. Besides communication, UWB is perfect for sensing/radar applications. For example, in child safety where UWB based Radar can detect periodic muscle movement such as breathing or general human presence. UWB Radar can also detect various movements around the Car such as kick to open the trunk, an intruder or an occupied seat. About RF Transceiver Group in Connectivity: Texas Instruments RF Connectivity group is expanding their RF Transceiver Design group. This group develops cutting edge RF Transceiver products (+MCU integrated) for Wireless-LAN (WIFI) and Ultra-Wideband Systems (UWB). The candidate will join in the UWB Design group. Candidate gets to experience Block Architecture Phase, Concept Design and take the design through the various design phases such as Schematic, Layout, Extracted simulations and Test and Verification. The role is primarily in Analog/RF class of circuit design to meet the overall System & Product requirements. The typical blocks include RF blocks such as LNA, TA, Down-conversion Mixers, Base-band filters, High Speed ADC to send data to the Modem. Reverse Chain namely for Transmitter, starting from DAC, Base-band filter, Up-conversion mixer and Power Amplifier stages to drive the TX Pin. LO system design including Chrystal Oscillator, integer/fractional PLL and LO Distribution systems. Various Calibration modules (AGC, PDET, Gain, Offset, IQMM, etc) to calibrate the Transceiver chain is part of the design. Low Current Mode and Complex Power Management to operate at low LDO input voltage etc. The Design Engineer in RF Connectivity gets introduced to a Holistic view of the product including, Radio Silicon Design, Packaging and PCB and solution design. About the

ROLE:
We are hiring one lead level IC Design Engineer with demonstrated design cycle experience. Some of the possible roles are: PLL & Clock System Design IF filter and VGA Design Transmitter Design ADC Design Candidate should have gone through 1 complete design cycle of an RF transceiver: namely Architecture, Schematic Design, Layout Design, Tape Out, Test & Validation and identifying design fixes for subsequent Tape Out. title: System-On-Chip Architect (SOC)
jobDescription:
responsibilities will include system partitioning, architectural modeling, power domain optimization & interface specification development of microcontroller systems supporting multiple operating modes. As a system architect, you will define architectural requirements and specifications for devices & IP. You will develop innovative system-level solutions to complex integration challenges through evaluation of various processing approaches and power management techniques. You will lead cross-functional architectural initiatives to ensure timely delivery of platform specifications with strategic oversight on... Job Description Change the world. Love your job. In this position, you will be architecting mixed-signal microcontroller systems featuring ARM Cortex-M0+/M33/RISC-V processors, as well as defining the overall system architecture for integrated platforms that combine high-performance analog peripherals with advanced digital communication interfaces as part of comprehensive So C solutions. Your responsibilities will include system partitioning, architectural modeling, power domain optimization & interface specification development of microcontroller systems supporting multiple operating modes. As a system architect, you will define architectural requirements and specifications for devices & IP. You will develop innovative system-level solutions to complex integration challenges through evaluation of various processing approaches and power management techniques. You will lead cross-functional architectural initiatives to ensure timely delivery of platform specifications with strategic oversight on routine architectural decisions and detailed technical guidance on next-generation embedded system innovations. This position involves extensive collaboration with a highly talented team of analog designers, digital circuit engineers, embedded software architects, and applications engineers to solve complex system integration challenges and present architectural vision, as well as active leadership in technical working groups driving innovation in microcontroller platforms and industrial automation solutions. Qualifications ## Minimum Requirements:
1. 10+years of relevant experience in system architecture or digital design
2. Deep understanding of ARM Cortex processor architectures and embedded system design
3. Thorough knowledge of system-on-chip (So C) architecture and subsystem integration methodologies
4. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze complex system-level challenges and develop innovative solutions
5. Solid foundation in digital design principles and hardware/software interface design ##

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:
1. Proven track record of translating system requirements into implementable architectural specifications
2. Demonstrated expertise in architecture trade-off analysis
3. Experience with Cortex-M families and their ecosystem
4. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills for resolving multi-disciplinary technical challenges
5. Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
6. Ability to adapt quickly to evolving requirements in a fast-paced environment
7. Excellent verbal and written communication skills ## Additional

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:
1. Ability to look at end to end solutions & derive system requirements.
1. Ability to evaluate and convert high level requirement into a HW and/or SW features.
2. Assess high level market requirements for cost, power, security, safety implications.
3. Work with estimation tools (simulators, spreadsheets, Python tools, matlab models, etc) to model performance of design choices.
4. Work with design-oriented tools and outputs (xml, sims, waveforms, etc)
5. Ability to make good judgements based on early / partial data
6. Ability to do "what if" thinking to make sure that IP/SOC definitions are not missing opportunities or falling behind. About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. title: Functional Safety Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Change the world. Love your job. We are seeking a highly skilled Functional Safety Engineer/Lead to join our Application-Specific Microcontrollers (ASM) Business Unit at Texas Instruments. The ASM BU develops advanced microcontroller solutions for safety-critical applications, with a primary focus on automotive and industrial markets. Our portfolio includes high-performance MCUs designed for ADAS, body electronics, powertrain control, industrial automation, and motor control applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in functional safety standards and practices, with a proven track record in developing safety-critical systems for the semiconductor industry. This role requires strong coordination skills to manage 3P assessments (TÜV SÜD and similar certification bodies) and to lead cross-functional teams in developing Functional Safety work packages in accordance with project Fu Sa plans. Technical Expertise: Practising knowledge of ISO 26262 and IEC 61508 standards Proven experience in coordinating functional safety assessments with 3P assessors (TÜV SÜD, TÜV Rheinland, or equivalent certification bodies) Strong track record of coordinating cross-functional teams to develop Fu Sa work packages according to Functional Safety Plans Expert-level proficiency in developing safety collaterals, including: FMEDA (Failure Modes, Effects and Diagnostic Analysis) FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Safety Plan and Safety Concept development Safety Case documentation Fault-Injection analysis Demonstrated ability to calculate safety metrics: SPFM (Single Point Fault Metric) LFM (Latent Fault Metric) FIT (Failures in Time) Strong knowledge of safety architecture for microcontroller ASICs/So Cs Professional Skills Excellent external stakeholder communication skills, particularly with 3P assessors and certification bodies Strong cross-functional team coordination and leadership abilities Proven ability to manage multiple work streams and drive deliverables to completion Experience in facilitating technical reviews and achieving consensus across diverse teams Analytical problem-solving mindset Attention to detail and commitment to quality Qualifications

title: Senior Digital Mixed Signal DV Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About TI Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! Who are we and what do we do? The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions! By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! Senior Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) Verification Engineer Location: Bangalore, India Experience: 3–10 Years What will you be doing in this role? Verification Strategy: Develop detailed coverage-driven Verification Plans by collaborating closely with System, Application, and Design teams. Modelling & Simulation: Create high-fidelity analog behavioural models using Verilog-A, Verilog-AMS, Wreal (RNM) or EENet to enable efficient top-level simulation. Environment Development: Build and enhance mixed signal testbenches using a combination of schematic, models, and RTL. Checkers & Assertions: Implement real-time analog checkers and post-processing checker strategies to ensure functional correctness. Full-Cycle Verification: Execute RTL and Gate Level Simulations (GLS), running regressions and tracking functional coverage goals until tape-out. Collaboration: Work with Digital DV, Analog Designers, and Post-Silicon Validation teams to debug complex issues and ensure successful product delivery. Qualifications Basic Requirements (Must-Haves)

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) design verification. Modelling Skills: Proficiency in analog behavioural modelling using Verilog-AMS, Verilog-A, or Wreal. Verification Flow: Direct experience with mixed-signal verification involving a combination of schematic, behavioural models, and RTL. Tool: Strong command of Cadence Virtuoso/AMS Designer toolsets and debug environments or other standard mixed-signal simulation tools Communication: Clear ability to present technical analysis and conclusions to internal stakeholders and business leaders. Preferred Skills & "Good to Have" (Innovation & Automation) Advanced DV: Knowledge of System Verilog (SV) and UVM, as the top-level environments are built on these frameworks. Automation: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Perl, or Shell) to automate simulation flows and data analysis. Exposure and interest in building AI-driven verification methodologies. Domain Expertise: Experience in signal processing, PMICs, or high-speed communication interfaces. Silicon Interaction: Experience in silicon debug and working alongside silicon validation teams. Standard protocols exposure: Verification experience with I2C, SPI, UART, ASI etc. About Us Why TI? Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. title: Lead AMS Verification Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description About TI Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job! Who are we and what do we do? The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions! By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! Senior Digital Design Verification (DV) Engineer Location: Bangalore, India Experience: 5–10 Years What will you be doing in this role? Verification Strategy: Drive the verification strategy, create detailed Test Plans with testcases, checkers and coverage and develop comprehensive Test Benches for Chip Top levels. UVM Architecture: Responsible for grounds-up development of the DV environment, including coding UVM components like agents, drivers, monitors, and scoreboards. Full-Cycle Execution: Execute RTL and Gate Level Simulations (GLS), running regressions and tracking functional and code coverage (Block, Expression, Toggle, FSM) to achieve 100% closure. Worked on standard communication protocols like I2C, ASI, SPI, UART etc. Write assertions (SVA), coverages for verification completeness. Technical Debugging: Utilize excellent debugging and problem-solving skills to resolve complex design and testbench issues. Post-Silicon Support: Interact with Product and Application Engineering teams to support ATE functional pattern generation and silicon characterization. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Architecture, Design, and Firmware teams to ensure successful product execution. Qualifications Basic Requirements (Must-Haves)

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering. Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in IP-level and So C-level Digital Design Verification. Core Competencies: Strong expertise in System Verilog (SV) and UVM methodologies. Tools: Proficiency with Cadence simulation tools and environments (e.g., Xcelium, Vmanager, Jasper Gold). Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to interact with worldwide cross-functional experts and stakeholders. Formal Verification (FV): Experience with Formal property verification (FPV), Connectivity checks, and Unreachability (UNR) analysis for top-level sign-off. Clock & Reset Domain: Understanding of CDC (Clock Domain Crossing) and RDC (Reset Domain Crossing) assertions, with the ability to write and debug them. Low Power Verification: Specific experience with UPF (Unified Power Format) for low-power verification and power-aware simulations. Preferred Skills & "Good to Have" (Innovation & Automation) Automation Mindset: Ability to automate verification flows and repetitive tasks using Python, Perl, or Shell scripting. Mixed-Signal Exposure: Basic knowledge or exposure to AMS (Analog Mixed-Signal) verification environments is an added advantage. Methodology Innovation: Ability to innovate and drive improved verification methodologies and work with EDA teams to upgrade tools. Exposure to building AI-driven verification methodologies.
